outputs.explanation: Spatial cluster image overlaid on tissue section; not a bar/box/violin plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
H&E histology images with manual region annotations; not a quantitative summary plot, so the check does not apply.
H&E images and spatial gene expression heat-map overlays showing per-spot expression levels; this is akin to a heatmap, not a bar chart of averages, so individual points are not applicable.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values derived from differential gene expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test) across thousands of spatial spots per gene, not a simple mean of a small number of replicates; each bar is a single computed statistic (fold change with associated p-value) rather than an average with underlying discrete data points that could be meaningfully overlaid.
